spec_case: issue #722 (gh tool, pass-through to the GitHub CLI)
description: `runtime.plugins.gh.binary` points both engines at the same fake `gh`, by absolute path. The harness still keeps the host `PATH`, so the case's own `fakes/gh` -- a decoy that fails loudly if it's ever reached -- is what a regression back to a plain PATH lookup would find instead of the configured override.
